g.aria-label: ingestion_jobs (sn-be-tbl-ingestion-jobs) – postgres at migration 013; owner rest-api (enqueue, retry), worker (schedule, claim, settle), start-dev.sh (transition_scoring seed); concurrency: unique (kind, idempotency_key); SKIP LOCKED claim; lease 300s (scrape 1800s); attempts/max_attempts; exponential backoff to 3600s; dead state; prune succeeded after 14 days
g.title: ingestion_jobs (sn-be-tbl-ingestion-jobs) – postgres at migration 013; owner rest-api (enqueue, retry), worker (schedule, claim, settle), start-dev.sh (transition_scoring seed); concurrency: unique (kind, idempotency_key); SKIP LOCKED claim; lease 300s (scrape 1800s); attempts/max_attempts; exponential backoff to 3600s; dead state; prune succeeded after 14 days

g.aria-label: library schema (sn-be-tbl-library) – postgres at migrations 101, 180-185; owner worker library_ingest; rest-api sets routes; concurrency: one transaction per ingest payload; job idempotency key
g.title: library schema (sn-be-tbl-library) – postgres at migrations 101, 180-185; owner worker library_ingest; rest-api sets routes; concurrency: one transaction per ingest payload; job idempotency key

g.aria-label: user_oauth_tokens + api_keys (sn-be-tbl-oauth) – postgres at sql/init/07-api-keys.sql; owner rest-api music_auth and api_keys routers; concurrency: upsert on (service,user_id); single user default_user
g.title: user_oauth_tokens + api_keys (sn-be-tbl-oauth) – postgres at sql/init/07-api-keys.sql; owner rest-api music_auth and api_keys routers; concurrency: upsert on (service,user_id); single user default_user

g.aria-label: target_tracks (sn-be-tbl-target-tracks) – postgres at migration 012, 280; owner rest-api target_tracks router; library ingest auto-promotion; scrape_targets; concurrency: scheduler UPDATE ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; playlists_found under row lock; unique live (artist,title) once 280 applies
